title: Fix three bugs in a Rust generic Stack
description: Fix bugs in Stack<T>: pop removes from front instead of end (FIFO not LIFO), peek returns first() instead of last(), size returns len+1.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in src/lib.rs:
1. pop: change `self.items.remove(0)` to `self.items.pop()` for LIFO behavior
2. peek: change `self.items.first()` to `self.items.last()` to return the top element
3. size: change `self.items.len() + 1` to `self.items.len()`
All 3 cargo test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test --quiet` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
